The framework

Clarity at
every step.

Points to clarify when discussing
a representation agreement.

01

Written terms

Define the work, responsibilities, and scope of authority.

02

Transparent compensation

Understand commission, any service fees, and agreed payment terms.

03

Rights & approvals

Identify the rights involved and the decisions requiring author approval.

04

Confidential materials

Agree how manuscripts and private communications will be handled.

05

Documented communication

Keep a clear record of submissions, discussions, and decisions.

06

Defined next steps

Clarify expectations and how the working relationship may end.
